segments.text: This level gives us a git repository served over SSH, hosted under the account bandit twenty-seven git.
I log in as bandit27 with ssh bandit27@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
The lab blocks the localhost ssh hop, so I clone from this client.
I run git clone on the ssh URL for the repo.
Git pulls the objects and checks out the working tree.
I read the README in the repo.
It gives the password for bandit twenty-eight in plain text, and the level is solved.
